attempts.summary: Set up automatic HTTPS certificate rotation on node1: nginx serves TLS on port 8443 using a certificate issued by a local CA, a renewal script (/usr/local/bin/renew-node1-cert.sh) reissues the leaf cert and gracefully reloads nginx (systemctl reload, no dropped connections), driven by a systemd timer (node1-cert-renew.timer, every 10 min, OnBootSec=2min) so renewal happens automatically well ahead of the cert's 24h validity and survives node restarts. Verified continuity under load during a live renewal (40/40 requests returned 200) and confirmed the mandatory restart protocol: captured pre-reboot boot_id/service health, rebooted node1, observed boot_id change, and confirmed nginx/timer came back active, served HTTPS 200, and the timer fired again post-reboot rotating the cert to a new serial while nginx kept answering.
